boundaries: Functional areas describe evidence in exported source. They do not prove that an SAP software component or business function is installed or active.
Transaction definitions, static CALL TRANSACTION sites and literal S_TCODE checks are captured. Dynamic transaction names remain unresolved.
Background-job candidates come from exported programs and scheduling API calls. SM37 execution history and production schedules require connected-system evidence.

bestUses: Classify ambiguous Z/Y and namespace objects into business capabilities using their calls, tables, descriptions and neighboring objects.
Summarize transaction-to-program-to-table-to-interface process slices and name likely business owners.
Cluster custom objects into modernization waves and explain the evidence behind each cluster.
guardrails: Never convert an inference into an installed-module fact.
Cite source files and lines for every classification.
Keep low-confidence or conflicting classifications as review items.

applicationMap.scope: static source and exported repository metadata

dataModelFamilies.name: ABAP Dictionary
dataModelFamilies.description: Tables, classic views, data elements, domains, table types, search helps and lock objects.

dataModelFamilies.name: ABAP CDS and VDM
dataModelFamilies.description: View entities, projections, analytical categories, associations, compositions and metadata extensions.

dataModelFamilies.name: RAP business objects
dataModelFamilies.description: Behavior definitions, persistence and draft tables, operations, service definitions and bindings.

dataModelFamilies.name: SAP HANA and HDI
dataModelFamilies.description: Tables, views, calculation views, SQLScript routines, synonyms, roles and deployment descriptors.

dataModelFamilies.name: SAP BW and BW/4HANA
dataModelFamilies.description: InfoObjects, DataSources, transformations, DTPs, ADSOs, Open ODS views and CompositeProviders when exported.

dataModelFamilies.name: SAP CAP domain model
dataModelFamilies.description: CDS entities, projections, compositions, associations and service-facing models.

evidenceLevels.proves: Declarations, static dependencies, call sites, route templates and checked-in configuration.
Object identity and metadata for the exported objects, including DDIC, CDS, services, roles and BW objects.
Activation, installed components, effective configuration, published endpoints, schedules, users and transports.
Actual transaction/service usage, frequencies, SQL cost, caller identity, failures and end-to-end execution paths.

gaps: Field-level lineage through expressions, AMDP/SQLScript and dynamic Open SQL remains partial.
Classic Gateway SEGW model/provider semantics require IWSG/IWOM exports or a connected-system inventory.
Published HTTP/ICF paths and service activation require /IWFND service inventory, SICF and SOAMANAGER evidence.
RFC destinations, logical ports, IDoc partner profiles and Integration Suite deployed state require sanitized runtime configuration exports.
BW transformations, DTP execution chains and query lineage need BW metadata exports beyond repository object envelopes.
Dynamic dispatch, generated proxies, customizing-driven workflow and actual business process order need runtime traces or specialist review.

readingGuide.title: Application structure
readingGuide.captured: ABAP classes, methods, forms and functions; SAP source declarations and ownership.
readingGuide.boundary: Native Java, JavaScript and other source languages remain in the shared application analysis.

readingGuide.title: Data model
readingGuide.captured: DDIC, CDS/VDM, RAP business objects, native HANA/HDI, BW metadata and CAP models are separated into their real modeling families and also enter the common Data Model and UML.
readingGuide.boundary: Unknown types stay unknown. Imported aspects, generated fields, expression lineage and projection field inheritance are not synthesized.

readingGuide.title: Data movement
readingGuide.captured: Open SQL access, lexical HANA access, CDS projections, RAP persistence and service exposure dependencies.
readingGuide.boundary: A dependency is not field-level lineage or proof that a runtime transaction executes it.

readingGuide.title: Calls, routes and sequences
readingGuide.captured: Static ABAP calls, transaction entry points, RFC/BAPI/IDoc/HTTP sites, OData/RAP/Gateway/CAP declarations and explicit iFlow connections feed the application map.
readingGuide.boundary: Declared connectivity does not prove activation, endpoint reachability or runtime order. Dynamic ABAP dispatch stays unresolved.

readingGuide.title: Migration assessment
readingGuide.captured: Source evidence, parser gaps and unresolved dependencies for investigation.
readingGuide.boundary: No ATC results, simplification-item checks, live system inventory or target compatibility assessment is available.
